_comment: Streamer Mode for World of Tanks 2.4.1 -- copy this file to <game>/mods/configs/akemi.streamermode/config.json
_mode_comment: 'label' = replace the nickname with e.g. Player_001 (recommended); 'blank' = show nothing at all
_namePrefix_comment: Prefix used in 'label' mode; a 3-digit counter is appended. Leave EMPTY to follow the client language automatically (玩家_ on a Chinese client, Player_ elsewhere). Any value here overrides that.
_bot_comment: Official bots (the client shows them as ':Name Surname:'). They get their own prefix and their own counter, e.g. Bot_001. Use 机器人_ for a Chinese prefix.
_exclude_comment: Who keeps their real name. All default to true.
_hideClanTag_comment: Also hide the clan tag shown next to a stranger's name
_hideResultsClanTag_comment: The post-battle results screen reads the clan tag straight from the player record, so it needs its own switch
_badges_comment: Badges/medals drawn next to nicknames. A rare medal identifies a player about as well as the name does, so hiding is the default.
_profile_comment: When you open ONE player's details/profile, show their real name instead of the label. Set to false to keep that window masked too.
_scope_comment: Which screens are anonymised. All default to true.
